scope: Configure Nautilus without quitting or launching the file manager.

checks.command: Run steps.nautilus.install() twice in a disposable KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland guest running Nautilus 46.4. Verify the default folder handler, unchanged process ID and empty OpenLocations after installation, then the same process and Documents URI after reinstall.
Verify Tahoe archive SHA-256, version and Nautilus installer source against the qualified candidate.

coverage_limits: Focused shared installer step on KDE neon, using the Tahoe source.
